review.notes: Accepted with corrections applied in place. Checked: upstream form (Summary, Scope and ownership, Conventions, Exact supplier contracts, How to read the build, layers with Examples and Dependencies, Corrections, Downstream consumers, References; no process language); fidelity of all 38 plan targets (scripted packet-to-README comparison, every flag read against the packet); every Scholze locator by script against the published PDF (sha256 ebac854f…), plus the Chenevier, Caraiani–Le Hung, Stacks (11 tags), Bhatt–Scholze, diamonds and AGIKMS locators by hand; all 63 supplier items against the supplier packages and packets; duplication against current TauCetiRoadmap (IntegralHeckeAndGaloisDeterminants in particular) and the Tau Ceti library; at least three Checks on every definition; an adversarial pass on every Check and worked example. Corrected: (1) §3a.3 polynomiality proof: the shift is X ↦ XT^{−m_0}, and Q_0 can be cancelled only after expanding the remaining product in powers of T (its T-coefficients are polynomials in X); the published proof and the package's correction both expanded in X. (2) §4.8 nonlifting example omitted K_∞ = {±1} from the GL_1 symmetric space, which as written gives a trivial stabiliser and no class; fixed, with that failure recorded as a negative control. (3) §2a.1 example called the empty boundary (I = O) the whole boundary. (4) §1.6 now states integral H^1 vanishing (Milnor sequence) as the plan does. (5) §0.2 cocycle condition on triple overlaps added; the Lemma 2.1.1 item is a clarification, not a correction. (6) The unconditional CM form cited a supplier id ET.7a that the EndoscopicTransfer package does not define; its §13.4 covers standard hermitian spaces only and its Labesse form (§6.29) needs a regular coefficient system, which the weights of π_k (n ≥ 2) are not. The contract is rewritten as Uses (Layers 1, 5, 6, 13) plus Required in addition (Shin's Theorem 1.1, appendix to Goldring, for the similitude group of U(n,n)). (7) Locators: Corollary 5.1.7 pp.1036–1037; Remark 5.1.3 is not a theorem; Proposition 5.1.1 p.1032; Remarks 5.4.5–5.4.6 p.1061; Theorem 4.2.1 pp.1021–1023; proof of Theorem 4.3.1 pp.1028–1031; Theorem 4.1.1 pp.1018–1020. (8) Mathlib name Algebra.isIntegral_trace; §2.5 codimension is the CC.5 grade; §4.4 names the next-degree Tor term; §1.2 uses Scholze's all-p version of PerfectoidShimuraVarieties §3.9. Suggested.lean: two examples added (rank-one dual polynomial; zero coefficient ideal). lean-check exits 0 with only proof-placeholder warnings (31), 321 lines, Mathlib only; a run_cmd audit finds no placeholder in any statement or definition body; no data definition has a placeholder body. intake.py check-files: 0 problems. metadata.toml topic = "math.NT" kept.
